_comment: PLACEHOLDER FILE. /setup replaces every [BRACKET] with your own values and writes config/search_profile.json. Running the pipeline on this file as-is will find nothing useful — that is intentional. Every list here steers sourcing and scoring. Re-run /setup --section <name> to update one part.

candidate.name: [YOUR NAME]
candidate.work_authorization: [US citizen | Permanent resident | F-1 OPT, needs sponsorship]

master_toolkit: [skill or tool that should earn fit points]
[another keyword you'd expect in a matching posting]

domains.name: [Priority Domain 1]
title_keywords: [word that appears in matching job titles]

known_non_sponsors.example defense prime: Illustrative: defense contractor, US-persons only. Replace with your own findings.
known_non_sponsors.example corp: Illustrative: confirmed no sponsorship for this job family. Replace with your own findings.

known_sponsors._comment: Employers you know sponsor, when USCIS data is thin. Points out of 30.
